analysis.headline: OpenAI announces new math, computer science and physics discoveries
analysis.summary: OpenAI announced new discoveries in mathematics, computer science and physics, including a claimed disproof of the Exponential Time Hypothesis, this time using outside 'shepherd' experts to vet results. The announcement follows an earlier mass release of manuscripts, and some researchers say they remain frustrated with how OpenAI communicates its breakthroughs.
